title: Distributional Determinantal Point Process for Repulsive Clustering of Distributions
abstract: arXiv:2607.21847v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce the distributional determinantal point process (dDPP) as a novel repulsive point process whose atoms are probability distributions rather than points in a real space. The dDPP is constructed via an L-ensemble with a sliced Wasserstein (SW) kernel between distributions. We show its validity as a well-defined point process. In the discrete setting, we derive concentration results for plug-in estimators of the L-ensemble, the correlation kernel, and their determinants given i.i.d. samples from the distributional atoms. Leveraging this framework, we propose a distribution-valued random partition model by way of a repulsive generalized Bayesian mixture model. The model places a dDPP prior over the atoms of the mixing measure and defines a generalized likelihood based on SW distance. To summarize posterior inference, we develop a decision-theoretic approach to report a point estimate of the mixing measure as a Bayes rule

translated_title: 分布性行列式点过程用于分布的排斥聚类
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.21847v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：我们引入了分布性行列式点过程（dDPP）作为一种新颖的排斥点过程，其原子是概率分布而非实空间中的点。dDPP通过一个基于分布之间切片Wasserstein（SW）核的L-集合构建。我们证明了其作为定义良好的点过程的有效性。在离散设置中，我们推导了基于分布原子i.i.d.样本的L-集合、相关核及其行列式的插件估计量的浓度结果。利用这一框架，我们通过排斥广义贝叶斯混合模型提出了一种分布值随机划分模型。该模型在混合测度的原子之上放置dDPP先验，并基于SW距离定义广义似然。为了总结后验推断，我们开发了一种决策理论方法，将混合测度的点估计报告为贝叶斯规则。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的分布性行列式点过程（dDPP），利用切片Wasserstein核在分布空间实现排斥聚类，并构建了相应的广义贝叶斯混合模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel distributional determinantal point process (dDPP) with a sliced Wasserstein kernel for repulsive clustering of distributions, and develops a generalized Bayesian mixture model with decision-theoretic posterior inference.
